title: SpectraNorm: a Python package for spectral normative modeling
description:
A Python package for spectral normative modeling of neuroimaging and other high-dimensional data. Spectral normative modeling (SNM) leverages eigenmodes for efficient spatial reconstruction, generating normative ranges for arbitrary regions of interest across spatial scales.

Documentation: https://sina-mansour.github.io/spectranorm/

creators.name: Mansour L., Sina
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore & The University of Melbourne
